audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text calls Blunt Force Trauma his Q and credits it with a "low-health self-heal and mana refund"; wants.you[1] tells you to dodge Blunt Force Trauma to deny sustain.
audit.why: Blunt Force Trauma is his E — a self-buff and a bag slam, not a thrown cleaver, and it cannot be dodged. The cleaver is Infected Bonesaw (Q, 4s, 975 range). And Dr. Mundo has no mana at all: every ability in the kit costs 0 and he pays health instead, so there is no mana refund to deny. His healing lives on Heart Zapper (W), which stores a portion of the damage he takes and heals him from it, and on Maximum Dosage (R).
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text rewritten with the correct slots, the 4s cleaver and the health-cost mechanic; wants.you[1] re-pointed at Infected Bonesaw.

audit.whatIsWrong: Goes Where He Pleases is never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: It resists the FIRST immobilizing effect that hits him. Wukong's entire kill pattern ends in Cyclone's knockup, and against Dr. Mundo the opening knockup can simply be eaten by the passive — you need a throwaway CC spent first, or the ultimate you saved for the kill window does nothing. This is the single most important interaction in the matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[3].why, phases[4].why, dontsFull[0].d and the cooldown block.

audit.why: The drmundo__wukong mirror flipped exactly these four rows and specifically called out phases[4]: Level 6 does NOT flip to Dr. Mundo, because Cyclone is what beats his ultimate heal. The packet chart is Dr. Mundo / Wukong / Dr. Mundo / Wukong / Wukong / Dr. Mundo / Dr. Mundo and matches.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3 and 4 flipped in BOTH layers as one matched group; whys[4] re-pointed at Level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns on the page, so 'engage when Heart Zapper is down' had no window attached.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s, Infected Bonesaw is 4s flat, Blunt Force Trauma is 9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6s, Maximum Dosage is 120s flat. The 17s Heart Zapper is the burst window; the 4s cleaver is why you cannot simply wait him out.
audit.corrected: 17s Heart Zapper into phases[2].why, phases[3].why, dosFull[0].d and the cooldown block; 4s Infected Bonesaw into phases[0].why, spikes[0].text and wants.you[1]; 120s Maximum Dosage into phases[4].why and the cooldown block.

edits.before: Dodge Blunt Force Trauma to deny sustain

notes: Two hard errors here. First, Blunt Force Trauma was written as his Q with a 'self-heal and mana refund' — it is his E, and Dr. Mundo has no mana in this kit at all (every cost is 0, he pays health). Second, and worse by omission: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect, which means Wukong's saved Cyclone knockup can be eaten outright, and no line on the page said so. mid and late still contain the 'Q sustain' framing and should be swept next pass.
